units.source_text: 源氏公子接得回信，反复阅读，然后长叹一声，自言自语地说：“可怜呵！”

en.t: Prince Genji received the reply, read it over and over, then gave a long sigh and murmured to himself, "How pitiful!"

units.source_text: 紫姬回头向他瞟了一眼，也自言自语地低声唱起古歌来：“人似孤舟离浦岸，渐行渐远渐生疏。”

en.t: Lady Murasaki turned her head and cast him a sidelong glance, then softly sang an old poem to herself: "Like a lonely boat leaving the shore, one drifts farther and farther away, growing ever more estranged."
After she finished singing, she sank into deep thought.

units.source_text: 源氏公子恨恨地说：“你的误解真太深了。

en.t: Prince Genji said resentfully, "Your misunderstanding is truly too deep.

units.source_text: 我说可怜，也只是顺口说出的。

en.t: When I said 'pitiful,' it was only something that slipped out.

units.source_text: 我回想那地方的情状时，往往觉得旧事难忘，就不免自言自语。

en.t: When I think back on the circumstances of that place, I often feel that old matters are hard to forget, and I cannot help murmuring to myself.
Yet you take every word of it to heart."

units.source_text: 他仅将明石姬来信的封面给紫姬一看。

en.t: He merely showed Lady Murasaki the cover of the letter from the Lady of Akashi.

units.source_text: 紫姬看见笔迹非常优美，为贵族女子所不及，心中不免惭愧，妒恨地想道：“原来如此呵！

en.t: When Lady Murasaki saw that the handwriting was extraordinarily beautiful, surpassing that of noblewomen, she could not help feeling ashamed, and thought with jealous bitterness, "So that is how it is!
